Legal & Compliance

Application Policies

Transparent legal disclosures and privacy statements for Finey users and App Store compliance.

Privacy Policy

Last Updated: August 1, 2026 | Compliant with Google Play & Apple App Store Guidelines
Open Dedicated Page ↗

1. Overview & Commitment

Finey ("we", "our", or "the App") prioritizes absolute user privacy. Finey is designed as an offline-first personal financial manager. We do not operate user tracking servers, remote analytics databases, or monetization advertising networks.

2. Data Collection & Local Storage

All financial records, expense categories, notes, calendar entries, and budget limits entered within Finey are saved locally on your mobile device using Hive local database storage. This data never leaves your device unless you manually initiate a CSV export.

3. Device Permissions

  • Notification Permission: Requested solely to schedule local daily expense reminder notifications on your device.
  • Storage / File Export Permission: Requested only when you choose to export your transaction history as a CSV file to your device's downloads folder.

4. Third-Party Data Sharing & Advertising

Finey contains zero third-party ad networks (such as Google AdMob, Meta Audience Network, or Unity Ads) and zero behavioral trackers. We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal financial information under any circumstances.

5. User Rights & Data Deletion

You maintain 100% control over your data. You may clear all application data anytime via the app's settings menu or by clearing local app storage in your mobile device's operating system settings.

Terms of Service

Effective Date: August 1, 2026
Open Dedicated Page ↗

1. Acceptance of Terms

By downloading, installing, or using the Finey mobile application, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the application.

2. Financial Disclaimer

Finey is an analytical expense tracking and organizational utility tool. Finey does not provide certified financial advice, tax preparation services, banking services, or credit consulting. Always verify tax and financial calculations with a licensed professional.

3. User Responsibility & Device Backups

Because Finey stores data locally on your device, you are responsible for maintaining your device's security and creating periodic backups using our CSV export feature.

4. Intellectual Property

The Finey software, branding, UI designs, icons, and codebases are owned exclusively by Finey's creators and protected by global copyright and software protection laws.

Refund & Cancellation Policy

Effective Date: August 1, 2026
Open Dedicated Page ↗

1. Free Application Tier

Finey provides core expense tracking features free of charge. You can download and utilize all local database logging and CSV export features with zero subscription commitments.

2. In-App Purchases & Subscriptions

If you purchase optional premium features or tip the developer via Google Play Billing or Apple App Store In-App Purchase, transactions are subject to the standard refund policies of the respective app stores:

  • Google Play Store: Request refunds directly through Google Play Purchase History within 48 hours of purchase.
  • Apple App Store: Request refunds directly through Apple's "Report a Problem" portal (reportaproblem.apple.com).

Data Safety & Security Policy

Security Standard: Hive No-Cloud Architecture
Open Dedicated Page ↗

1. Device Sandbox Security

Finey stores your expense history inside your mobile operating system's isolated sandbox storage using binary Hive key-value boxes. No unauthorized apps can access your financial logs.

2. Zero Telemetry & Zero Cloud Breach Risk

Because Finey does not host a centralized database or remote web API for transaction storage, your financial information can never be exposed in a remote cloud database leak.
